narr: Scattered slow moving thunderstorms developed over southeast Arizona during the morning and afternoon. Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding in Pinal County, the Tucson Metro area and over the Contreras Fire burn scar.
ev: Heavy rain of 1-2 in less than 2 hours over the Santa Catalina Mountains caused flash flooding in San Manuel and nearby areas with several dirt roads washed out.
Heavy rain of 2-3 in 2 hours fell across the Rincon Mountains causing rises in Tanque Verde Creek that caused road closures of Wentworth Rd. and Tanque Verde Loop Rd.
